speedup.time: Cuts {{time}} off a construction or research.
speedup.hours_one: Cuts {{min}}–{{count, number}} hour (at random) off a construction or research.
speedup.hours_other: Cuts {{min}}–{{count, number}} hours (at random) off a construction or research.
speedup.percent: Cuts {{percent}} of the total time off a construction or research.
speedup.troopBatch: Cuts {{percent}} of the total time off one troop training batch.
speedup.fortBatch: Cuts {{percent}} of the total time off one fortification batch.

loyalty: Raises a hero's loyalty by {{amount}} (up to {{max}}).

experience.share: Gives a hero experience: {{percent}} of the next level, at least {{min}}.
experience.level: Gives a hero experience: a full level, at least {{min}}.

holyWater: Clears all of a hero's assigned points so they can be assigned again.
buff: {{effect}} for {{period}}. Using another extends the time.
civilCode: Adds {{percent}} of the maximum population (at least {{min}}) to the current city.
cureInjured: Heals every injured troop in the current city at once.
heroBox: Recruits a level {{level}} hero with every base stat at least {{minStat}}. Needs a free {{building}} slot.
teleporter: Moves your city to a free flat tile of your choice, then cools down for {{period}}.
truce: Truce: your cities cannot be attacked for {{period}}, but you cannot attack either.
notUsable: Not usable on this server yet.
noEffect: Event item with no effect on this server.

howTo.speedup: Use from a construction (in the Town or Fields) or research (in Research) in progress.
howTo.troopsSpeedup: Use on a batch in Military's training queue.
howTo.fortificationsSpeedup: Use on a batch in Military's fortification queue.
howTo.cityMove: Use with "Move city here" on a free flat tile on the Map.
howTo.heroesReset: Use from a hero's Points dialog in Heroes.
howTo.heroesUseItem: Use from a hero's Items button in Heroes.
howTo.key: Use the {{chest}}; the key is taken automatically.
howTo.welcome: Every new player gets one when they start; it cannot be bought.
